## Invitations

A total of 6753 invitations were issued for the outreach activity. Of those invited, 5254 people attended, representing an attendance rate of 77.8 per cent. The figures provide a clear summary of participation among those contacted and invited to attend.

The outreach arrangements were maintained across the area, with van days kept where roads allowed. This supported delivery of the activity under the conditions available during the reporting period.

## Contact

Contact was supported through text messaging and reminder messages. SMS was used with 5705 invitations, and 5705 people received a reminder message. These communications provided additional contact for people who had been invited and helped maintain awareness of the outreach arrangements.

The report was prepared by G. Evans.
